description: This file defines a React-like component using the Qwik framework for editing notes. It includes props definitions, internal signals, event handlers for updating and deleting notes, and JSX structure for UI rendering.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: Main component rendering a note editor with handlers for update and delete actions, uses signals and Qwik's event system.

methods.name: handleTitle
methods.description: Event handler for updating the note's title, triggers on input event.

methods.name: handleContent
methods.description: Event handler for updating the note's content, triggers on input event.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Event handler for deleting the note, triggered by delete button.
